pr.title: feat(github): detect merge-queue enter/exit via GraphQL
pr.body: Closes #25. Merge-queue enter/exit (GitHub). Adds two event kinds — `EnteredMergeQueue` and `RemovedFromMergeQueue { reason: dequeued | unmergeable }` — detected via GraphQL (`isMergeQueueEnabled` + `pullRequest.mergeQueueEntry.state`), which REST doesn't expose. ### Auto-detected, not opt-in No config flag. navi reads `isMergeQueueEnabled` per PR and only tracks queue state for repos whose base branch actually uses a merge queue — so these events fire **solely for repos that use one**, and are **on by default** (`rules.events.entered_merge_queue` / `removed_merge_queue`, mutable). A "no queue" verdict is cached per repo (`mqcfg:`, 24h TTL) so repos without a queue stop getting queried after the first look; enabling a queue later is picked up on the next re-check. ### Design In `process_pr`: skip via the per-repo cache when possible, else one combined GraphQL call returns `(is a queue enabled, current entry state)`. When enabled, the state is diffed against a per-PR cursor (`mq:`). *Actively queued* = an entry in any state other than `UNMERGEABLE`; entering fires on inactive→active, removal on active→inactive (`unmergeable` when it went UNMERGEABLE, else `dequeued`). First sight baselines silently. - **No double-alert on merge:** when a PR leaves the queue because it merged, the `Merged` event already covers it, so the removal is suppressed. - Trigger reuse: the existing `track_prs` involved-PR sweep already polls your authored PRs, covering the "dequeue doesn't notify you" gap. - New kinds are rendered by all three destinations (Slack/Discord/email). Note: also updates `navi-e2e`'s Slack `send` call to the new #7 signature (that binary is feature-gated, so #84's checks didn't compile it). ### Tests Pure transition matrix; wiremock poll tests for entered-on-transition, silent-first-sight, no-queue-repo (emits nothing + caches the verdict), and merge-doesn't-double-report-removal; config default-on test. - 🟣 ~~[feat(github): detect merge-queue enter/exit via GraphQL (#85)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/navi/pull/85)~~ (merged) 👈 - 🟣 ~~[feat(slack): thread a PR's events under one Slack message (#84)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/navi/pull/84)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[feat(gitlab): diff MR notes for merged/closed/comment-reply/ready (#83)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/navi/pull/83)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[feat(github): opt-in first-run backfill via general.backfill (#82)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/navi/pull/82)~~ (merged) - `main` --- Stack managed by [git-stk](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk)

expected.description: Merge-queue headlines use pr_phrase, which renders "their own PR" with no preceding actor, producing misleading notification text.

prior_bot.note: bot flagged injection and cursor issues, not headline wording
